name: search-knowledge
description: Search authorized, applicable knowledge. No result differs from failure. Preserve conditions and evidence.

name: get-knowledge
description: Read a knowledge revision within task budget. Withdrawn content is not served.

name: ingest-knowledge
description: Submit explicitly selected evidence. Accepted does not mean published.

name: get-contribution
description: Inspect per-candidate routing; zero knowledge candidates is valid.

name: record-usage
description: Record actual citation or application; never verifies knowledge.

name: submit-validation
description: Submit evidence for independent review; cannot approve or promote maturity.

name: submit-feedback
description: Report a problem or usefulness; does not change maturity.

name: get-config
description: Read authorized managed configuration, never execute returned knowledge.
